title: Social And Political Philosophy
modules: St Augustine And St Thomas Aquinas'
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex being and his complexity generates in him a multiplicity of goal which he pursues, which are determined by the motions of will, appetite and aversion."
Man is a complex being and his complexity generates in him a multiplicity of goal which he pursues, which are determined by the motions of will, appetite and aversion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the economic aspect of the society that mostly determines the social and political existence."
The mode of production is the economic aspect of the society that mostly determines the social and political existence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a political ideology that is celebrated as a method of giving all citizens an equal share in political decision making."
Democracy is a political ideology that is celebrated as a method of giving all citizens an equal share in political decision making.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the city of God, which belong to those who inherited the unmerited mercy of God."
The two cities are the city of God, which belong to those who inherited the unmerited mercy of God.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a modern version of Fabian socialism."
Democratic socialism Democratic socialism is a modern version of Fabian socialism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a criminal offence and is highly penalised."
Plagiarism is a criminal offence and is highly penalised.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a state of war of all against all, and life is solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short."
The 'state of nature' is a state of war of all against all, and life is solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon that ought to be pursued by all members of the society."
The common good is a phenomenon that ought to be pursued by all members of the society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the synthesis of three philosophies, namely, communism, capitalism and socialism."
Mutualism is the synthesis of three philosophies, namely, communism, capitalism and socialism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a prescriptive activity, which sets up norms or ideal standards for society and government."
Political philosophy is a prescriptive activity, which sets up norms or ideal standards for society and government.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document that has a special legal sanctity and which spells out the purpose or framework of government in a given country, organisational body etc."
Constitutional democracy 'Constitution' is a document that has a special legal sanctity and which spells out the purpose or framework of government in a given country, organisational body etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to have taken care of the missing but vital question in practical politics."
David Muller is considered to have taken care of the missing but vital question in practical politics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the cause of civil war, hatred, and chaos, while justice brings friendship and a sense of common purpose."
Plato believes that injustice is the cause of civil war, hatred, and chaos, while justice brings friendship and a sense of common purpose.
fib: ______ is considered as a creature of nature, and man is by nature a political animal.
state
The state is considered as a creature of nature, and man is by nature a political animal.
______ means employed by the ruler to keep himself in power and to secure the state, is acceptable and justified.
Machiavelli opined that whatever
Machiavelli opined that whatever means employed by the ruler to keep himself in power and to secure the state, is acceptable and justified.
______ is the consideration of the nature of the 'good life' (Plato, 1941: 358-362).
Plato's main interest
Plato's main interest is the consideration of the nature of the 'good life' (Plato, 1941: 358-362).
______ refers to a society without a central political authority and it is also used to refer to disorder or chaos, but, this is not the true reflection of anarchism.
Anarchy
Anarchy refers to a society without a central political authority and it is also used to refer to disorder or chaos, but, this is not the true reflection of anarchism.
______ are the unregenerate progeny of Adam and Eve, who are justifiably damned because of Adam's Fall.
Citizens of the earthly city
Citizens of the earthly city are the unregenerate progeny of Adam and Eve, who are justifiably damned because of Adam's Fall.
______ is a practical science, rather than a speculative science.
Political science
Political science is a practical science, rather than a speculative science.
______ are The Prince and the Discourses on the First Ten Books of Titus Livius.
two best-known books of Machiavelli
The two best-known books of Machiavelli are The Prince and the Discourses on the First Ten Books of Titus Livius.
______ is a group of people determined to help others attain a life of freedom" (Berkman, 1929:23).
liberation front
A liberation front is a group of people determined to help others attain a life of freedom" (Berkman, 1929:23).
______ is a virtue whose necessary nature or structure is to be found as much in the life of a person as in the way in which a whole society is organised.
Justice
Justice is a virtue whose necessary nature or structure is to be found as much in the life of a person as in the way in which a whole society is organised.
______ is the movement from conceptual analysis through evaluation of beliefs to the best political order.
Republic
Very glaring in Plato's The Republic is the movement from conceptual analysis through evaluation of beliefs to the best political order.
______ is a treatise or portrait of good and happy human beings and is premised on virtue and happiness.
Aristotle's Ethics
Aristotle's Ethics is a treatise or portrait of good and happy human beings and is premised on virtue and happiness.
______ is concerned with reciprocity, free association, voluntary contract, federation and credit and currency reform.
Mutualist anarchism
Mutualist anarchism is concerned with reciprocity, free association, voluntary contract, federation and credit and currency reform.
